sentences.text: The Common Carder Bee has been recorded visiting the flowers of Marsh Thistle, Devil's-Bit Scabious, Greater Knapweed, Meadow vetchling, Creeping Thistle, Bush Vetch, field scabious, and Foxglove.
In the Mainz-Bingen region the main time runs from April to September, with reports peaking in August.
